name: bounds_rhs_order
source:
PROCEDURE Main()
LOCAL a := {1,2}
LOCAL n := 0
ErrorBlock({|e|Break(e)})
BEGIN SEQUENCE
? a[0] += bump(@n)
RECOVER
? n
END SEQUENCE
RETURN
FUNCTION bump(n)
n++
RETURN 5
